name: dsh-memory-win
description: Windows-first long-term memory for the DSH desktop app: plain markdown shards with a per-step map injection (path / entry count / latest date / keywords) and on-demand retrieval through the memory_search tool. Zero shell, zero external process, zero dependency — roots resolve at call time from DSH_HOME/homedir so the global layer cannot silently vanish on Windows, memory is split into a global layer plus a per-project layer (inside the repo) plus named shards under each, behaviour thresholds come from a single config layer, a daily capacity pass physically archives superseded entries and empty shards, since 0.3.0 a read-only Memory View settings page browses layers and shards without ever writing, and since 0.4.0 a compaction guard backs the session log up before the host compacts it (named <title>_YYYYMMDD_HHmmss) and verifies the post-compaction message history against a target, converging at most once more.

scripts.test: node test/run.mjs && node tools/view-lifecycle.mjs && node tools/client-smoke.mjs && node tools/compat-check.mjs
